body:
## Why

Maint 71 updates the branch of a behind generated dev-tool PR. That changes its Git tree without refreshing the immutable Maint 52 delivery lease. Ready #589 and #591 then failed the correct desired_tree_mismatch guard and were closed unmerged.

## Scope

Repair the source-owned Maint 71 to Maint 52 refresh handoff for generated dev-tool deliveries. Preserve the existing lease verifier and exact-head merge guards.

## Non-Goals

- Do not patch or merge generated PRs directly.
- Do not replace a producer-signed desired tree hash with an observed tree hash.

## Tasks

- [ ] Update .github/scripts/maint71_merge_sync_prs.js so a behind leased dev-tool PR never calls pulls.updateBranch.
- [ ] Update .github/workflows/maint-71-merge-sync-prs.yml to dispatch or durably hand off one scoped Maint 52 producer refresh, deduplicating active runs.
- [ ] Add regression cases in .github/scripts/__tests__/maint71_merge_sync_prs.test.js for a behind dev-tool PR, deduplication, refreshed lease, and normal non-generated branches.
- [ ] Update docs/ops/CONSUMER_REPO_MAINTENANCE.md with the source-owner refresh route.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] node --test .github/scripts/__tests__/maint71_merge_sync_prs.test.js passes with zero updateBranch and merge calls for a behind leased dev-tool PR.
- [ ] Maint 52 mints a new lease on the current base before Maint 71 applies exact-head check, thread and seven-minute gates; desired_tree_mismatch remains fail-closed.
- [ ] After source promotion, Ready receives one newly generated Maint 52 PR and source-owned Maint 71 reconciliation, with no direct generated-PR mutation by this lane.
